backend/main.mo: Motoko canister defining trade, account, user profile types with CRUD operations, performance metrics, and authorization checks using AccessControl.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing a footer modification requirement and listing affected files, components, tests, and confidence level.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summary map of various frontend files, describing their roles in routing, layouts, UI components, and data logic.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom design tokens for light and dark themes and global base styling.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point that loads the React app via main.tsx and sets the page title and viewport meta tags.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React router setup defining public and admin routes, layouts, and global providers including theming and site-wide gate.
Admin layout component providing dashboard header, logout handling, and container layout for admin pages.
frontend/src/components/app/AppHeader.ts: Header displaying the site wordmark linked to the homepage.
frontend/src/components/app/PublicFooter: Public footer showing trading disclaimer and copyright year with removed attribution elements.
frontend/src/components/app/PublicLayout: Public-facing layout with header, navigation bar, background texture, main content slot, and footer.
frontend/src/features/admin/components/A: Dialog form for creating or editing managed accounts, handling form state and submit mutations.
Admin table listing accounts with options to add, edit, and delete using dialogs and mutations.
frontend/src/features/admin/components/C: Panel for uploading and validating CSV trades and importing them via add-trade mutations.
frontend/src/features/admin/components/M: Form card to view and update performance metrics through controlled inputs and a mutation call.
frontend/src/features/admin/components/T: Dialog form for adding or editing a trade, managing field state and submit mutations.
Displays and manages trades with add, edit, and delete actions using tables and dialogs.
frontend/src/features/admin/hooks/useAdm: Provides React Query mutation hooks for adding, updating, and deleting trades, accounts, and metrics.
frontend/src/features/admin/pages/AdminD: Renders the admin dashboard with tabbed views for trades, accounts, metrics, and CSV import.
frontend/src/features/admin/utils/csv.ts: Parses CSV trade data and returns validated trades along with row-level validation errors.
frontend/src/features/analytics/componen: Draws an SVG-based equity curve chart with grid lines, area fill, and axes.
Renders an SVG bar chart showing monthly profit and loss values.
Displays a donut chart and legend summarizing win/loss trade distribution.
frontend/src/features/analytics/pages/Pe: Loads trades and metrics and displays monthly P&L, win/loss, and equity curve charts.
frontend/src/features/analytics/utils/an: Provides helpers to compute monthly PnL, win/loss counts, and an equity curve from trade data.
frontend/src/features/auth/components/Ad: A gate component that checks admin authentication and redirects or blocks access based on auth state.
frontend/src/features/auth/hooks/useAdmi: Custom hook that verifies Internet Identity authentication and queries whether the user is an admin.
frontend/src/features/auth/pages/AdminLo: Admin login UI that triggers Internet Identity auth and redirects authenticated admins to the dashboard.
frontend/src/features/auth/types.ts: Defines simple auth state and status types for admin authentication flows.
frontend/src/features/data/queries.ts: React Query hooks to fetch performance metrics, trades, and managed accounts from the backend actor.
frontend/src/features/public/components/: Renders a small SVG growth chart based on simulated data derived from an account balance.
UI controls for filtering trades by month, year, and result.
Displays a styled table of trades with direction, prices, quantity, and P&L formatting.
frontend/src/features/public/pages/HomeP: Public landing page showing overall trading performance metrics and stats from backend data.
frontend/src/features/public/pages/Manag: Displays managed accounts with masked names, balances, risk profiles, and growth charts, handling loading and empty states.
frontend/src/features/public/pages/Portf: Shows trade history with filters for date and results, rendering a table or skeletons during loading.
frontend/src/features/public/utils/maski: Masks account names by keeping the first and last two characters and replacing the middle with asterisks.
frontend/src/features/seo/usePageMeta.ts: Sets the document title and meta description using a React effect.
frontend/src/features/siteGate/GateScree: Renders a login form for gated site access with error and loading states.
frontend/src/features/siteGate/SiteWideG: Wraps content with a site-wide access gate, validating credentials and handling navigation on success.
frontend/src/features/siteGate/useSiteGa: Manages gate unlock state via sessionStorage and validates hardcoded username/password.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and helpers for managing Internet Identity login, identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and theme variables for light and dark modes with trading-focused color palettes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL and hash parameters plus persisting them in sessionStorage, including utilities to clear parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme colors, fonts, animations, container settings, and plugin usage.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata, versions, and feature requests for the footer update.
